select t2.BK_ACCT_NO as cashacctID, t3.BANKCODE as bank, t2.EXTERNALACCTNUMBER as bankAcct, t3.BANKDESC as bankAcctName, t4.CURR_CODE as localCurCode, t1.income as localBalance, t4.CURR_ID as curCode from (select cf.BK_ACCT_NO, round(sum((case when cf.DBCR='C' then -1*(cf.FXORIGBAL-cf.FXREMAINBAL) else (cf.FXORIGBAL-cf.FXREMAINBAL) end)),2) as income from bk_cash_flow cf where cf.PORTFOLIO=#{portNum} and cf.LEDGER<=#{endDate} group by cf.BK_ACCT_NO) t1, bk_cash_acct t2, bk_info t3, fx_currency t4 where t1.BK_ACCT_NO=t2.BK_ACCT_NO and t2.bankid=t3.bankid and t2.CURRENCYCODE=t4.CURR_ID
